visual.general_description: Two side-by-side grayscale sector-format ultrasound images with a red arrow on each.
visual.detailed_description: Two black-background grayscale sector-format ultrasound images share the figure, separated by a thin white vertical divider. The text "LOGIQ" over "E9" is printed at the upper left of each sector. In the left image the sector is filled with mid-gray echogenic tissue with a broad vertical dark band through its centre and a small bright echogenic focus to the right of that band; a red arrow in the left part of the image points down and to the right toward a curved bright echogenic margin near the lower-left edge of the sector. In the right image the upper part of the sector is a darker, finely textured area, with a dark wedge-shaped region bordered by a bright linear echogenic interface below it; a red arrow at the upper left of this region points to the right toward the tip of the dark wedge. Brighter echogenic bands lie in the lower part of the sector. No axis labels, scale, measurement calipers, colour Doppler overlay or panel letters are visible.

visual.general_description: Three axial CT slices of the upper abdomen in a row, each with a red arrow at the peripheral edge.
visual.detailed_description: Three axial grayscale CT slices at the level of the upper abdomen are shown side by side, each with the vertebra and ribs visible in bright white and a thick red arrow outside the body outline pointing inward at the peripheral margin of the abdominal contents. In the left slice the arrow is at the upper left of the image and the interior is a diffusely mottled mid-gray with no clearly separated structures and no bright vessel visible. In the middle slice the arrow is at the left edge; a bright round vessel lies in front of the vertebra, a lobulated darker region lies at the lower left of the interior, and a darker crescent-shaped band follows the peripheral margin. In the right slice the arrow is at the upper right of the image; a bright round vessel lies in front of the vertebra, a larger rounded darker heterogeneous region lies at the lower left, and a darker band lies along the peripheral margin adjacent to the arrow tip. No scale, numeric annotation, text label or panel letters are visible.

visual.general_description: Four axial MRI slices of the upper abdomen in a two-by-two grid, each with a white asterisk at the same region.
visual.detailed_description: Four axial grayscale MRI slices of the upper abdomen are arranged in a two-by-two grid on a black background, each with a white asterisk marking a lobulated region at the left side of the image. In the top-left slice the asterisked region is bright (high signal) against a darker surrounding organ, with a smaller bright round focus to its right and a dark round vessel near the vertebra. In the top-right slice the asterisked region is dark (low signal) against a gray surrounding organ with a smaller dark round focus to its right. In the bottom-left and bottom-right slices the asterisked region is heterogeneous, with dark irregular areas interspersed with bright rim or fragment-like areas, and a smaller dark round focus lies to its right; a bright round vessel lies in front of the vertebra. The images carry no text labels, scale, sequence names or panel letters.
